fact_text: A common dividend screen requires at least five years of consistent dividends and a dividend yield near bank deposit rates; the analyst argues this screen ignores whether the business will keep earning.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'THE MYTH OF DIVIDEND INVESTING - WEALTH DESTRUCTION MODE ON' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Eight stocks picked in 2010 by the dividend screen, with yields of about 10 to 11%, returned about 11.5% a year on average over 14 years, or 13 to 14% with reinvested dividends, growing wealth 5 to 6 times.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'THE MYTH OF DIVIDEND INVESTING - WEALTH DESTRUCTION MODE ON' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Over the same 14 years from 2010, a KSE-100 index-weighted portfolio, rebalanced once a year with no company analysis, grew wealth about 7.5 times, beating the dividend screen.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'THE MYTH OF DIVIDEND INVESTING - WEALTH DESTRUCTION MODE ON' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Engro Fertilizer was part of Engro Corporation in 2010 and was listed separately on the PSX only in 2014.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'THE MYTH OF DIVIDEND INVESTING - WEALTH DESTRUCTION MODE ON' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Engro Fertilizer built a plant costing about USD 1.1 billion between 2007 and 2011.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'THE MYTH OF DIVIDEND INVESTING - WEALTH DESTRUCTION MODE ON' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The Engro Fertilizer plant did not run at full capacity until 2015 because of gas supply problems, showing how feedstock supply risk can hold back a fertilizer plant.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'THE MYTH OF DIVIDEND INVESTING - WEALTH DESTRUCTION MODE ON' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Retail investors skipped Engro Fertilizer's 2014 IPO because of the gas problems, but the analyst argues the conditions of 2014 no longer describe the industry.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'THE MYTH OF DIVIDEND INVESTING - WEALTH DESTRUCTION MODE ON' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Engro Fertilizer's returns since its 2014 listing are in the 18 to 20% a year range, according to the analyst.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'THE MYTH OF DIVIDEND INVESTING - WEALTH DESTRUCTION MODE ON' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Engro Corporation returned about 13 to 15% a year over 14 years from 2010, so swapping it in for Engro Fertilizer would barely change the portfolio result.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'THE MYTH OF DIVIDEND INVESTING - WEALTH DESTRUCTION MODE ON' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Fauji Fertilizer kept cutting its dividend from about 2013 to 2016 despite a long record of paying one, showing that past dividend consistency does not guarantee future payouts.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'THE MYTH OF DIVIDEND INVESTING - WEALTH DESTRUCTION MODE ON' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A screen based on past payouts can select companies whose dividends later stop, and the dividend approach gives no rule for what to do after a payout is cut.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'THE MYTH OF DIVIDEND INVESTING - WEALTH DESTRUCTION MODE ON' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Dividend yield equals the dividend divided by the share price, so a falling price mechanically raises the yield and can lure investors into a deteriorating business.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'THE MYTH OF DIVIDEND INVESTING - WEALTH DESTRUCTION MODE ON' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Fast-growing businesses reinvest most profits and pay small dividends, and high-quality firms may pay out almost all earnings, so a yield-near-bank-rate screen rarely picks future winners.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'THE MYTH OF DIVIDEND INVESTING - WEALTH DESTRUCTION MODE ON' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst argues dividend payers tend to stay closer to fair value, because holders receive cash every quarter or half-year and are less likely to sell in a panic.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'THE MYTH OF DIVIDEND INVESTING - WEALTH DESTRUCTION MODE ON' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst says a meaningful long-term investing test needs at least 15 to 25 years of history rather than a short window.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'THE MYTH OF DIVIDEND INVESTING - WEALTH DESTRUCTION MODE ON' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst's principle is to invest only in what you fully understand, meaning how a company earns money and which factors can raise or lower its profit.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'THE MYTH OF DIVIDEND INVESTING - WEALTH DESTRUCTION MODE ON' (YouTube transcript, undated)
